messages:
emily (product): Quick proposal — add an opt-in "auto-pin-renew" flow for customers + a one-time migration-credit bundle for forced deprecations. Goal: reduce churn during catalog rollouts and give sales a clear offer. Thoughts?

tyler (eng): quick q — is auto-pin-renew a server-side policy or client opt-in?

emily (product): server-side toggle per-tenant + API flag. Default off. Customers can opt in to auto-renew pin when we propose a model swap. We control grace window and can auto-apply fallback on failure.

rafa (eng-ml): benchmark gating needs to change if we auto-accept swaps. Propose: if new model passes perf/quality gates vs pinned model (\u2265 98% quality on eval set AND latency within 1.2x), we can auto-swap. Otherwise require manual customer acceptance.

sophia (support): support burden concern — customers will message us if swaps feel different. We should include an in-console diff + sample outputs pre-swap. Also we need a migration-credit SKU to placate enterprise legal asking for mitigations.

omar (sales): migration-credit sounds good. Suggest 3-month free traffic reroute credits or $5k credit for big accounts. Need clear eligibility rules. Also: how do we communicate to customers? Banner + email?

emily (product): agreed. Proposed comms: 1) console banner + in-app modal when an auto-swap is scheduled; 2) one-off email to billing contacts; 3) API webhook for customers who want programmatic notice.

opsbot: Deploy checklist created: https://internal.redwood/sops/auto-pin-renew-checklist 

tyler (eng): engineering estimates: ~2 wks infra + 1 wk canary rollout. Hard part: safe rollback hooks and KV cache invalidation on per-tenant swap. We'll need a canary lane for dedicated tenants.

rafa (eng-ml): on eval gating: recommend we use the current benchmark harness but add a new "acceptance delta" param. Example config snippet: 
```
pin_policy: auto_renew
acceptance: {
  quality_threshold: 0.98
  latency_multiplier_max: 1.2
  sample_eval_ids: ["smoke-1", "nlp-cust-abb"]
}
migration_credit: {
  type: "monthly_waiver"
  months: 3
}
```

sophia (support): also require a rollback SLAT in runbook (e.g., rollback within 30m if customers open >3 high-sev tickets after swap).

emily (product): good call — add an operational SLA. For enterprise we mark auto-renew opt-in as "managed" and include rollback promises.

omar (sales): pricing ask: can we make migration credits auto-apply for accounts > $100k ARR? That makes contract language easier.

t_yler (eng): @tyler (typo): meant to say we'll need telemetry: per-tenant A/B capture, sample inputs stored (short TTL), and automatic quality regressions alerting. ETA bumped to 3 wks if we include that.

tyler (eng): oops, sorry — yes we need that telemetry. +1 on 3 wks if we capture samples.

rafa (eng-ml): one more voice on gating: add semantic-safety check (no sudden increase in hallucination score). We can compute a lightweight LM-based hallucination metric from eval set. Threshold: no >1.5x increase.

sophia (support): can we pre-pack an FAQ + canned responses for CS to reduce noise? Otherwise ops will drown during the first couple of rollouts.

emily (product): will draft FAQ + customer message templates. Action items: Tyler -> infra build & telemetry hook (owner). Rafa -> acceptance metric definitions + eval IDs. Sophia -> support runbook and canned responses. Omar -> draft sales eligibility & credit tiers. I'll draft product PRD + comms.

tyler (eng): ack. I'll add a canary toggle per capacity pool and an emergency opt-out route.

rafa (eng-ml): ack — will add the hallucination metric and a small eval suite for quick gating (<= 5 min run).

sophia (support): putting a note on our backlog. Need a short training session for CS before canary opens.

omar (sales): will prepare a one-pager for enterprise AE teams. Request: final PRD by EOD Thu so we can review in Friday GTM sync.

emily (product): timeline looks feasible. PRD draft by Thu EOD. Quick standup Friday 10am PT to align on rollout lanes. :calendar:

opsbot: Meeting created: "Auto-pin Renew PRD review" Fri 10:00 PT — attendees: emily, tyler, rafa, sophia, omar 

emily (product): thanks everyone. Keeping this thread for async updates — please post short status updates here. :rocket:
